subject: Pilot top-up: invoice offset vs. ops credit — Novacare POC
messages:
From: Elena Martins <elena@novacare.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — 2-week pilot top-up & billing preference

Hi Karthik,

Quick one from our side: the pilot team hit a block on a throughput test and needs an extra 2 weeks to complete integration checks. We have two procurement preferences internally and wanted to confirm what you can support without needing a new contract:

- Option A: A $12k invoice offset applied to the first post-pilot invoice (we’d supply a PO)
- Option B: An equivalent ops credit (12k) applied as a one-time top-up inside the pilot account (no PO)

Which of the two consumes less redline time for you? We want to avoid re-issuing the whole SOW if possible — just a short runway augmentation.

Attached: none on this message.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Martins
Head of AI Integrations, Novacare
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Martins <elena@novacare.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 2-week pilot top-up & billing preference

Elena — thanks for flagging, and glad the team's close. Short answer: we can support both, but they follow different approval paths. Two options we can move on immediately:

1) Invoice offset (your PO) — fastest from an accounting standpoint if your finance team can approve the PO today. We’ll treat it as a one-line invoice credit applied to the next invoice. Requires a PO referencing deal NW-2027-041. Legal review minimal.

2) Ops credit inside the pilot — we can issue a one-time 12k platform credit (non-refundable) and apply it to the pilot account so your engineers get immediate capacity. This avoids a PO but needs an ops change request and a short internal approval from our finance ops team (low friction, usually same-day).

I’m looping Priyom (solutions) to confirm the capacity/throughput profile change so ops can pre-provision. Kimberly from legal is cc’d to confirm whether either approach needs an amendment to the SOW or is captured by existing terms.

If you can tell me which you prefer, I’ll get the right doc path started (PO template or credit request). If helpful, we can do a 15-min call at 11:30 PT.

Cheers,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Elena Martins <elena@novacare.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 2-week pilot top-up & billing preference

Thanks Karthik — quick tech note from our side: if you take the ops credit route we can pre-warm an extra GPU pool shard and increase token throughput for the two-week window with no change to the model variant. That’s the fastest way to unblock the integration test.

If you go invoice offset + PO, engineering still needs the onboarding flag to provision burst capacity; PO alone won't trigger the config change. So operationally, ops credit + our internal pre-provision is the lowest-latency path.

Elena — happy to jump on the 11:30 PT sync to confirm exact timestamps for the burst window.

— Priyom
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Elena Martins <elena@novacare.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, contracts@novacare.ai
Date: 2027-05-30T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 2-week pilot top-up & billing preference

Karthik / Priyom — thanks, that helps. Novacare will do the PO path (finance prefers an invoice offset for internal accounting). However, time is tight — can Redwood accept a PO today and do the pre-provisioning as soon as we confirm PO number? If we provide the PO by end of day, will your ops team proceed while legal completes any required notice?

We’d like:
- PO for $12,000 referencing NW-2027-041 (I’ll send to contracts@novacare.ai)
- Redwood to provision the extra shard upon PO receipt (engineers need burst by Monday 07:00 PT)
- If provisioning requires SOW amendment, keep it administrative (signature not required prior to the burst) — legal will sign after the fact if needed.

Attaching a placeholder PO to this thread (PO_template.pdf) and a short SOW edit that shows the requested two-week window (SOW-draft.docx).

Best,
Elena
Head of AI Integrations — Novacare
